# ex: avoid with method via selector expression
ex {
	var x int
	avoid T.M
	F(x) -> G(x)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{}
func (T) M() {}

func F(x int) int { return x }
func G(x int) int { return x + 1 }

func H() int { return F(1) }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,9 +1,10 @@
 package m

 type T struct{}
+
 func (T) M() {}

 func F(x int) int { return x }
 func G(x int) int { return x + 1 }

-func H() int { return F(1) }
+func H() int { return G(1) }
